functionDeclarations.description: Activate one discoverable skill and its dependencies.
functionDeclarations.name: load_skill

functionDeclarations.description: Set supplied wait/report overrides for the next attempted tool call only, including invalid calls and setters.
functionDeclarations.name: tool_limits

ai_callback_delay.description: Finite nonnegative wait seconds; default 3. Zero polls.

ai_callback_pattern.description: Go regular expression matching new output; empty clears the pattern.

max_output_bytes.description: Positive inline content budget; default 16384. Complete output stays on disk.

functionDeclarations.description: Remove one explicit skill root; retain shared dependencies and past manuals.
functionDeclarations.name: unload_skill

functionDeclarations.description: Create a file and missing parents. Refuse replacing an existing file without overwrite:true; append mode creates or appends.
functionDeclarations.name: write_file

append.description: Append or create; default false. When true, overwrite is irrelevant.

content.description: Exact text to write; empty text is valid.

overwrite.description: Allow replacement of existing bytes; default false.

path.description: File path, relative to the Agent workspace or absolute; not confined to workspace.
